record.paper_title: The cosmological constant, dark matter, supersymmetry, and other unsolved problems from a fresh perspective
record.context_brief: Origin of the Higgs boson mass
record.original_question: What is the physical origin of the Higgs boson mass in a fundamental theory that aims to extend the standard models of particle physics and cosmology?

evidence.quote: Examples are the origin of Yukawa couplings, the origin of the Higgs boson mass, the nature of dark energy

artifact.status_search_result: The origin of the Higgs boson mass and the associated electroweak hierarchy problem remain open problems in theoretical physics. No experimentally confirmed mechanism (supersymmetry, compositeness, relaxion, anthropic selection, etc.) has been established; LHC searches have so far found no new physics explaining the Higgs mass scale.

status_evidence.title: Hierarchy problem - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The hierarchy problem concerns why the Higgs mass is so much smaller than the Planck scale; it remains an unresolved problem.
status_evidence.claim: The origin/naturalness of the Higgs mass is an unresolved problem in physics.
